behaviors.behavior: The real regenerate_tracked_snapshots -> _update_compliance chain runs and all seven paths report a success outcome
The six tree-derived documents change against their committed seed, and none is deleted
ci-security.json keeps its committed bytes when its source is unreachable, still reports success, and does not break the run

The regenerated documents carry real derived content: both FR ids in the RTM, the seed's two commits in change-history, the seeded dependency in the SBOM, a v3 manifest whose requirement ids match the seed with no untagged tests
A fixpoint is reached in exactly 3 passes, strictly under MAX_PASSES
The rewritten producer config ends byte-identical, and was really rewritten mid-run (D6)
behaviors.evidence: ::test_the_rewritten_config_ends_exactly_where_it_started PASSED; mutation-verified - re-adding the config to APPEND_ONLY_INPUTS turns exactly this case red

behaviors.behavior: Both append-only logs keep every line they started with, in order, and each gained a record
An append-only input that moved is reported to the operator, and a rewritten one is not
The producer's own appends (one grade_snapshot per pass, one dedup'd triage row) do not break the fixpoint
converge's regenerate parameter still defaults to the real producer
An unsound seed, a readable seeded manifest, an un-neutralised gh, or outbox-routed triage fails as a FIXTURE fault before the producer runs
behaviors.evidence: assert_seed_is_sound runs inside the real_run fixture and gates the nine cases that consume it
